advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_h1_luc: Learn airbending in the Southern Air Temple
block.guhs.luchtscooter.lore: A toy for your guhs: a spinning ball of air. Whoosh, round and round!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_deur: Behind a closed door someone is tinkering. Who? You'll hear. Or rather: you won't hear yet.
The hall holds the statues of every Guhvatar before you. Two of them have something to tell you.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_kaas: Whoever has beaten Overlord Mika sees a &6glowing cheese ball&r wash up at the Nibble Mountain. Tap it open and see who was inside.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_luch: Play airball against &dAang Guh&r on the poles. Guhatso is the referee. First to three!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_momo: A glowing lemur guh snatches your nibble. Follow him and his trail of little clouds through the temple, up the towers and over the bridges.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_scoo: Step on the line under the start arch and race all the way round the track on an air scooter before the time runs out. Whoooosh!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_stal: Take the saddle in Appa's stable, put it on Appa and feed him three apples. A happy Appa is a flying Appa.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_vluc: Fly on &dAppa Guh&r to the &bSouthern Air Temple&r. No need to search: he knows the way.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_zuka: A Fire Nation ship rams the jetty. Escape on Appa and learn airbending: the first of the four elements!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h1_lucht_zwee: Jump off the south balcony at the top of the Great Tower and glide through the six rings. You may miss one.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.beloning.kreeg: You get the air nomad robe with the arrow and two air scooters for your guhs!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.beloning.luchts: Airbending (in the temple: air ball and air leap)
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.gong: In the distance the wind gong rings. Something is moored at the jetty: down on the landing terrace, on the east side!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.hier: The workshop! The closed door is in the west wall, under the lantern. Walk into it.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.klop: You knock on the closed door...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.titel_onde: Something is moored at the jetty...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.deur.werktuiggu: A voice behind the door: "Not finished yet, nyeg! Come back later. Much later!"
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.2: The spirits in the Hall of the Guhvatars
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.3: Monk Guhatso on the pie terrace
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.4: The start arch of the Air Scooter Track
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.5: The column of wind to the balcony
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.doel.stap.8: The closed door of the workshop
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.deur: The closed door of the workshop is %s, in the west wall of the long building east of the Hall.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.hal: The spirits of Roku-guh and Kyoshi-guh are waiting %s, in the big white Hall: up the stairs, through the gate, across the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.luchtbal: Monk Guhatso is standing %s, by the pies above the Airball Court. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.momo: The lemur guh is fleeing to the Monks' Tower, %s. Lost him? The door is on the south side of the tower.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.scooter: The orange-and-yellow start arch is %s, at the south edge of the temple. Step onto the line under it.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.stal: Appa's stable with the green roof is %s. The door is on the south side.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.zuka: The jetty is %s: down the big stairs, on the east side of the landing terrace.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.hint.zweven: The first ring is hanging %s. After that, the next ring always lights up blue.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kaasbol.klik: The cheese ball is warm and hums softly. Something is knocking inside!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kaasbol.melding: Something glowing is washing up at the Nibble Mountain... A cheese ball?
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.1: Did you see that? That ball didn't fly because of your hand, but because of the wind you gave it. That was airbending! A tiny bit, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.2: Now without a ball. Press %s, pick Air Leap in your power wheel and jump on the wind!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.3: Air Leap and Air Ball work everywhere in the temple. Go on, try them!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.bal: Whoosh! That's it! Air is light and free. You'll learn the rest on the way: running, gliding... and maybe one day blowing away a fireball.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.les.sprong: Whoa, did you see how high? Air doesn't push, air lifts you up. Now try Air Ball: a gust wherever you look.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.bal_te: The wind brings the ball back, right next to you.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.blaast: Aang Guh blows the ball back to you!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.jij: GOAL! The ball whooshes through Aang Guh's goal!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.schiet: Aang Guh shoots at your goal! Stop it!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.start: Airball! The glowing ball floats above the poles. Hop to a pole next to it and hit it (left click) towards Aang Guh's goal, on the far side. First to three!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.terug_: Floop! The wind puts you back on a pole.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.titel_: Hit the ball (left click) towards the goal on the far side
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.verlor: Aang Guh wins this time. Talk to Guhatso for a new match, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.luchtbal.weg: You left the court: the match stops. Talk to Guhatso to start again.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.daar: There he is! The glowing lemur guh, right in front of you. Follow him!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.jat: Hey! A little Bat-Lemur Guh snatches the nibble out of your hand and flutters off!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.toren: He flies into the Monks' Tower. After him, up the stairs!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.volg: Follow the glowing lemur guh! He leaves a trail of little clouds and waits for you if you fall behind.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.momo.wacht: Squeak! The lemur guh is waiting for you. Come on, follow the trail of little clouds.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.ontsnap.start: Run west, to Appa in the camp by the campfire! Dodge the fireballs and Zuka's men.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.ontsnap.terug: Zuka's men put you back at the start of the jetty. One more time, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.afgesta: You stepped off the air scooter. Step on the line under the start arch to ride again.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.gehaald: Made it in %s seconds! Guhatso claps his see-through little hands.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.klaar: You're standing on an air scooter! Look where you want to go, W is faster, S brakes, space jumps. Ride through every gate to the finish.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.stap_op: The Air Scooter Track starts here: step on the black-and-white line under the arch!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.te_laat: Time's up! No worries: step on the line under the start arch again and have another go.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.terug_o: Whoosh! The wind puts you back on the track.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.scooter.uitleg: Look where you want to go - W is faster
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.appa_komt: Appa plods into his old stable and sniffs at everything.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.appels: You take apples from the barrel. Now click Appa with them!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_appels: Take apples from the barrel to the left of the door (right click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_op_app: Click Appa with the saddle in your hand.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_voeren: Click Appa with an apple in your hand.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.doe_zadel: Take the glowing saddle off the wooden trestle, to the right of the door (right click).
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.klaar: Appa is happy: a whole saddle and a full belly. He licks your whole head. Eww. And: aww.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.vol: Appa is full. Three apples is enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_gepa: You take Appa's saddle off the trestle. Now click Appa with it!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_klaa: The saddle is on! Appa looks at it approvingly.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.stal.zadel_zit_: The saddle is already on Appa.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.vlucht.fluit: Appa lands. Got off? Whistle for him with your Appa whistle and he'll fly you on.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.vlucht.mislukt: Appa can't leave yet: the wind doesn't know the way to the Air Temple yet. Try again in a moment, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.balkon: Jump off the balcony: you glide and sink slowly. Look at the blue ring!
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.gemist: Just missed! No worries: on to the next blue ring.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.je_zweeft: You're gliding! Look where you want to go. Looking down is faster.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.neergezet: The wind sets you down gently on the square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.op_balkon: You're on the south balcony at the top of the tall tower. Jump off: you glide and sink very slowly. Look where you want to go and fly through the six rings; the next one lights up blue.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.te_weinig: You glided through %s rings. No worries: the wind will put you back on the balcony in a moment, then you have another go.
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.wind_komt: Guhatso: "And now: gliding!" In a moment the wind lifts you up to the balcony of the tall tower...
gui.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.zweef.zuil: Whoosh! The column of wind lifts you up to the balcony.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.ding.luchtscoo: Guhs ride whooshing rounds on the air scooter.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h1_lucht.r: For a hundred years the Guhvatar slept in a cheese ball. Now the cheese ball is open, and the world is hungry.
High above the void floats the Southern Air Temple. This is where the air nomad guhs learnt to glide, to play and to share.
Aang Guh grew up here. It is quiet now, but the wind still knows the way.
Get to know the air, Guhvatar. She is light, free... and a little naughty. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.1: Fly with Appa to the Air Temple
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.2: To the Hall, talk to a spirit
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.3: Airball: Guhatso, west of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.4: Start arch south of the Airball Court
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.kort.9_: Run to Appa in the camp (west)!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.0: Open the glowing cheese ball that washed up at the Nibble Mountain.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.1: Fly on Appa to the Southern Air Temple. Got off? Whistle for him with your Appa whistle.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.2: Walk from the landing place up the big stairs to the north, through the temple gate and across the square. Go into the big white Hall with the tall tower on top. On the right (east) the spirits of Roku Guh and Kyoshi Guh stand in front of their statues, with a beam of light above their heads: talk to one of them.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.3: Leave the Hall and go west. Monk Guhatso stands by the pies on the terrace above the Airball Court (the court full of poles). Talk to him and play airball against Aang Guh: hop from pole to pole and hit the glowing ball with a left click towards Aang Guh's goal. First to three!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.4: Walk south from the Airball Court, to the edge of the temple. There stands the orange-and-yellow start arch with a beam of light and swirling little clouds. Step on the black-and-white line under the arch: you get an air scooter, and after 3-2-1 you're off. Look where you want to go, W is faster. Ride through every gate to the finish.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.5: The wind takes you to the south balcony at the top of the tall tower on the roof of the Hall (later the column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall does it too). Jump off the balcony: you glide and sink very slowly. Look where you want to go and fly through the six rings; the next ring lights up blue. You may miss one.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.6: A little Bat-Lemur Guh snatched your nibble! He flutters, glowing, right in front of you and leaves a trail of little clouds. Follow him: to the Monks' Tower in the northwest, into the tower and up, and over the roofs. If you fall behind, he waits for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.7: Go to Appa's stable: the big white building with the green roof between the two towers in the north, behind the Hall (the door is on the south side). To the right of the door, take the glowing saddle off the wooden trestle (right click), then click Appa with it, and give him three apples from the barrel to the left of the door (right click Appa with an apple).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.8: Something is ticking behind a closed door. Walk to the long, low building east of the Hall: the workshop. The big closed door is in the west wall, under the lantern and the beam of light. Walk into it or click it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.9: The wind gong rings: something is moored at the jetty! Walk south, through the temple gate and down the big stairs to the landing terrace where you arrived with Appa. The wooden jetty sticks out into the void on its east side (beam of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.9_vl: Escape! Run west across the landing terrace to Appa by the campfire in the camp (beam of light). Dodge Zuka's fireballs and his men.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.nu.klaa: Airbending learnt! Appa flies you to the Northern Water Tribe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.uitleg: A glowing cheese ball washes up at the Nibble Mountain. Inside: Aang Guh, the previous Guhvatar, and his sky bison Appa Guh. And you turn out to be the new Guhvatar. First: learn airbending in the Southern Air Temple.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.0: The Guheinde, at the Nibble Mountain (where the portal sets you down)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.1: The Southern Air Temple, high above the void
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.2: The big white Hall with the tall tower on top, north of the temple gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.3: The pie terrace above the Airball Court, west of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.4: The orange-and-yellow start arch, south of the Airball Court (the southwest corner of the temple)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.5: The south balcony at the top of the tall tower on the Hall (column of wind: the middle of the square in front of the Hall)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.6: Follow the glowing lemur guh (first to the Monks' Tower, northwest)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.7: Appa's stable, between the two northern towers (behind the Hall)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.8: The door in the west wall of the workshop, east of the Hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.9: The wooden jetty on the east side of the landing terrace (south, at the bottom of the stairs)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.9_: The camp with the campfire, west on the landing terrace
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_lucht.waar.kl: On the way to the Northern Water Tribe
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.deur: Do you hear that ticking? It comes from the workshop, the long building east of the Hall. The door is in the west wall. Go and have a look!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.hal: The Hall is straight ahead, the big white building with the tower on top. Inside on the right, Roku Guh and Kyoshi Guh are waiting. Well, their spirits. Don't be scared when they talk.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.luchtbal: Airball! Guhatso is by the pies on the terrace, west of the Hall, next to the court with the poles. I'll go and stand on my pole already. Fair warning: I'm good at it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.momo: A lemur guh snatched your nibble? Haha! They live all over the place here. Look, there he flutters, that glowing thing! Just follow him.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.0: Airbending is just like chonking: you mustn't try too hard.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.1: Up for some airball later? I've been practising in secret.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.na.2: It's less quiet here since you came. Nice, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.scooter: The Air Scooter Track starts at the orange-and-yellow arch, south of the Airball Court, at the edge. Step on the line and you're standing on a ball of air: the most fun thing there is!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.stal: Appa's old stable is the white building with the green roof between the two northern towers. The saddle is to the right of the door, the apples are on the left. He hasn't had an apple in a hundred years!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.steiger: Something's moored at the jetty, down on the landing terrace on the east side. A ship? Ships never come here...
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.vlucht: No talking: run! Appa is waiting in the camp!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.welkom: There you are! The Hall of the Guhvatars is straight ahead: through the gate, across the square, the big white hall with the tower on top.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.aang.zweef: To the balcony at the top of the tall tower? Step into the column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall: the wind lifts you up there. Jump, and trust the wind.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.gewon: Ha! Three to fewer than three! Aang Guh, you've been beaten by the new Guhvatar. Pie for everyone!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.later: The wind forgets nothing, young Guhvatar. Nor do I. Especially not where the pies are.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.lucht: I am monk Guhatso. Well: the memory of him. Aang Guh was my best pupil. Airball is simple: the glowing ball floats above the poles and always comes to rest above a pole. Hop to a pole next to it and hit it with a left click towards Aang Guh's goal, at the north end of the court. Whoever falls into the cloud, the wind puts straight back on a pole. First to three!
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.scoot: Well played! Now the Air Scooter Track. Walk south to the orange-and-yellow arch at the edge of the temple, and step on the line. You ride a ball of air: look where you want to go, W is faster, space jumps.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.vroeg: Ha! A new face. Or an old face in a new body? Come back once you've seen the Hall.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.guhatso.zweef: And now the best part: gliding. Jump off the south balcony at the top of the tall tower and fly through the six rings. The column of wind in the middle of the square in front of the Hall takes you up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.koning.oog: Oh, and grill skewer powder? You grind it from a grill skewer of the Spark Mikas in the Skewer Keep, in the Barbecuether. One skewer, two portions. There. Now you know everything, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.0: Be kind. But never let anyone simply take your nibbles.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.1: A fan is a weapon too. And a fine way to cool your tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.kyoshi.raad.2: I was the tallest Guhvatar ever. That means nothing. Except that I could reach everything.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.0: Air teaches you to let go. Water teaches you to go with the flow. Earth teaches you to stand. And fire... teaches you to be careful.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.1: Once I was too late to stop a fire. Be on time, Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht.roku.raad.2: A Guhvatar is not strong because he can do everything. He is strong because he is not alone.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_aankomst.temp: The Southern Air Temple. White, quiet and higher than the clouds.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_aankomst.thui: Home! Well... my old home. It's so quiet without the monks. Come on, first the Hall of the Guhvatars.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.blaas: Zuka's fireball flies straight at you. You sweep your arm aside, and the wind goes with it.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.gelee: Air is light and free. Just like a guh after dinner. You've learnt it, Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.volge: On to the Northern Water Tribe! Someone there will teach us waterbending. Yip yip!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_geleerd.zag_j: Did you see that?! You blew that fireball right aside! That's airbending!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.beelden: The hall holds the statues of every guh who was the Guhvatar before you. Their eyes seem to follow you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.kyoshi1: And I am Kyoshi Guh. One thing first: one element is not enough.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.kyoshi2: And don't forget to eat. A hungry Guhvatar saves nobody. I speak from experience.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.roku1: Welcome, young Guhvatar. I am Roku Guh. Long ago I stood where you stand now, with knees just as wobbly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.roku2: Air, water, earth and fire. Learn all four, in that order. Only then can you stop Fire Lord Mikai.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_hal.voetstuk: In the middle of the hall, one pedestal is still empty. It seems to be waiting for someone.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.guhvata: One guh could bend all four elements and made sure every nibble was shared fairly: the Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.jij: Now the cheese ball is open. The baton has passed to a new Guhvatar. To you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.jipjip: Come on! Appa will take us to my old home, the Southern Air Temple. That's where you'll learn airbending. Yip yip!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.mikai: Fire Lord Mikai ate and ate. And the more he ate, the hungrier the world became.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.slaap: But just when the world needed him most, he curled up in a cheese ball. For a nap of a hundred years.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.trek: Then everything changed when the Fire Nation got peckish...
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_intro.vroeger: Long ago, the four nations lived together in chonkiness.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.barst: A glowing crack runs across the cheese. It grows wider. The light grows brighter.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.drijf: High above the void, something glowing drifts towards the Nibble Mountain. Slowly. Solemnly. A little crooked.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.gaap: Haaaaa... What a nap. How long did I sleep? An hour? Two?
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.guhva: Whoa! Your eyes are glowing! Then you're... you're the new Guhvatar!
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.hallo: Oh! Hello! I'm Aang Guh. And that big hairy thing behind me is Appa. He's a sky bison. A guh sky bison.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.korra: ...Wait a moment. Your name isn't Korra, is it?
Korra? Never heard of her, nyeg. Forget I asked.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.ogen: Suddenly something tingles in you, from your little ears to your toes. Your eyes begin to glow...
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.plof: Plop. It rolls on a little... and lies still.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.stokj: I was the Guhvatar before you. I went for a little chonk in the cheese ball... and it turned into a hundred years. The baton is yours now.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kaasbol.verha: But first you need to know what happened while I was asleep. Sit down. It's an epic story.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_deur.tek: Something is ticking... behind that door.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_hal.teks: The Hall of the Guhvatars. Two spirits are waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_luchtbal: Monk Guhatso. He has a game for you, and pie.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_momo.tek: The Monks' Tower. That's where that lemur guh wants to go!
This is where the Air Scooter Track begins.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_stal.tek: Appa's old stable. He's hungry, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_zuka.tek: The jetty. Something is lying there... something big.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_kijk_zweven.t: The first ring. Jump, and trust the wind.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_knipoog_sjokk: On the Air Scooter Track, Shuckly has started his race too. He has all the time in the world.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.gevangen: In his little nest under the roof, the lemur guh finally lets himself be caught.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.naam: He has chosen you. From now on his name is Momo Guh, and he goes everywhere with you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h1_lucht_momo.terug: He puts your nibble neatly back in your hand. Then he climbs onto your shoulder and stays there.
BOOM! A Fire Nation ship rams the jetty. Planks fly everywhere.
Three years I have searched. If I bring you to my father, I get my honor back!
Get the Guhvatar! But gently, mind you. Father wants him in one piece.
Appa is waiting in the camp at the other end of the terrace. Run!
Prince Zuka. Banished, angry, and very, very determined. His men jump onto the jetty after him.
